findings.title: PR description references nonexistent companion PRs/issues for dim<1 validation
findings.claim: The PR description says it 'lands with #1093, which rejects dim < 1 in the metadata parsers' and defers work to #1085, #1086, #1106, #1091, but none of those PRs/issues exist in the repo. frame.go:861 still does dim, _ := strconv.Atoi(...), so a wire type of VectorType(Int32Type, abc) becomes Dimensions: 0 and an empty payload decodes to []int32{} with a nil error.

findings.title: "Zero dimensions never touches SubType" guarantee is false for an *any destination
findings.claim: unmarshalVector(VectorType{}, data, new(any)) reaches the interface branch at marshal.go:1044, calls info.Zero(), which calls v.SubType.NewWithError() on a nil interface and panics; the new comment and TestUnmarshalVectorZeroDimensionsDoesNotTouchSubType claim a property the code does not have, since the test only covers *[]float64.

findings.title: vectorElemMinSize dereferences a nil inner SubType
findings.claim: VectorType{SubType: VectorType{Dimensions: 3}, Dimensions: 2} panics in vectorFixedElemSize(nil) because the recursion recreates one level down the deref the outer guard was written to avoid; noted as caller-constructed only.

findings.title: Two error branches in the same function still return a nameless custom()
findings.claim: The vector branch's Atoi failure (also at helpers.go:264-267) logs through nopLogger from frame.go and returns NewNativeType(protoVer, TypeCustom), giving 'can not unmarshal custom() into *[]float32', which is inconsistent with the new comment at helpers.go:282.

findings.title: Undocumented behaviour change: NULL with negative dimensions now errors
findings.claim: Previously data == nil with Dimensions < 0 returned nil; the test pins the new behaviour on purpose, but the PR description's 'Behaviour change' section only mentions short or empty payloads, not this case.

findings.title: "Every new test fails against pristine" claim is overstated
findings.claim: TestUnmarshalVectorAcceptsWellFormedPayloads and TestUnmarshalVectorZeroDimensionsDoesNotTouchSubType pass on pristine code by design, and TestVectorElemMinSize cannot even compile there, contradicting the PR description's claim.

findings.title: Saturation branch (return math.MaxInt32) is untested
findings.claim: No row in TestVectorElemMinSize exercises the math.MaxInt32 saturation return at marshal.go:1136-1138, so a sign or off-by-one regression there would go unnoticed.

findings.title: Announced empty-payload change has no direct test
findings.claim: The description's vector<int,3> over []byte{} case is the exact boundary between the data != nil skip and the bound, but the closest existing test uses 2 bytes instead of an exact empty payload.

findings.title: Stale fast-path comment about nil/empty and dim=0 falling through
findings.claim: The comment 'nil/empty and dim=0 fall through to the generic path' is no longer true for empty non-nil data with Dimensions > 0, which the new bound now rejects first.

findings.title: Overstated comment claiming every path below allocates
findings.claim: The comment 'every path below turns it into an allocation' is overstated because the array destination at marshal.go:1075 allocates nothing, as the test comment at marshal_vector_test.go:640 itself acknowledges.

findings.title: Misleading test comment about zero-byte element description
findings.claim: The comment 'Neither can describe an element in zero bytes' is wrong for vector<float,0>, which does encode in zero bytes; the floor actually exists because the caller divides.

findings.title: PR description carries a "Generated with Claude Code" attribution line
findings.claim: The PR description contains an AI attribution line, which the user's global CLAUDE.md forbids in PR descriptions.

findings.title: Negative vint length decodes vector<text,1> to [""] with a nil error
findings.claim: A negative vint length still decodes vector<text,1> over nine 0xff bytes to [""] with a nil error; noted as pre-existing and out of scope, but the ticket meant to defer it does not exist.

findings.title: Full unit test run fails on TLS cert-parsing errors, but identically on main
findings.claim: Running the full unit suite fails in TLS tests with 'Failed parsing or appending certs'; this failure occurs identically on main, so it is environmental rather than caused by this PR.

findings.title: scyllacloud tests fail due to missing testdata/pki/ca.crt, but identically on main
findings.claim: The scyllacloud package fails due to a missing testdata/pki/ca.crt file; this failure occurs identically on main, so it is environmental rather than caused by this PR.

findings.title: Root package fails to build for GOARCH=386 on main, so 32-bit tests never run
findings.claim: The root package does not build for GOARCH=386 on main either, meaning the 32-bit test cases never run, independent of this PR.
